generated_note: ppg_rank_state/oppg_rank_state/mov_rank_state rank each team-season against every other team in that same season, statewide. ppg_rank_class/oppg_rank_class/mov_rank_class do the same within the team's classification for that season. ppg_rank_alltime/oppg_rank_alltime/mov_rank_alltime rank every team-season record against all team-season records from 2012-2025 combined. ppg_rank_class_alltime/oppg_rank_class_alltime/mov_rank_class_alltime do the same within the same classification across 2012-2025. Higher PPG/MOV = better rank; lower OPPG = better rank. Ties share the same rank. Note: the Sport Detail snippet's buildAlltimeIndex() re-derives ppg_rank_alltime/oppg_rank_alltime/mov_rank_alltime client-side from the raw ppg/oppg/mov values rather than trusting these precomputed fields, so this file only needs to guarantee raw values are present and accurate; the precomputed ranks here are for direct consumers of this file outside that snippet.
